channel.description: Research from Anneer Center for Policy and Strategic Studies

item.title: Is it a good idea for governments to be investing massively in data centers?
item.description: Our answer is yes. Computing is becoming as fundamental as electricity, but public money carries a duty private money does not: it must not leave citizens worse off.

item.title: Saudi Arabia Needs a National Strategy for Great Cities
item.description: Where new jobs, universities and public investment settle will shape the Kingdom for longer than almost any sectoral programme. That choice should be made deliberately.

item.title: Who Is Benefiting from Green Energy?
item.description: Renewable power is a deflationary technology. Its gains flow not to whoever owns the resource, but to whoever owns the constraint.
